question: When is the placement of tattva, form, and so on to be caused to be done as before?
premises: Placement of tattva, form, and so on is named.
It is to be done as before.
inference: Then one may cause the placement of tattva, form, and so on to be done as before.
uncertainties: Who performs the causing is not stated in these tokens.
plain_english: Then one may cause the placement of tattva, form, and so on to be done as before.
